name: Sarit Hadad
description: '''Sarit Hadad''' ({{langx|he|שרית חדד}}, {{IPA|he|saˈʁit χaˈdad| }}; born '''Sarah Hudadatov''', 20 September 1978) is an Israeli singer. She is one of the most popular ethnic singers in Israel, and named as the "best female singer of the 2000s decade" by the Israeli channel [[Channel 24 (Israel)|24]] in October 2009. She also represented [[Israel]] in [[Eurovision Song Contest 2002|Eurovision 2002]] with the song "[[Nadlik Beyakhad Ner|Light a Candle]]".
